main_text.p: ܢܘܒ ܕܥܘܫ Syr. Naufragium, ܠܥܘܫ ܕܥܘܫ Λ ܘܣ Fui in naufragio. Ex Græco ναυαγία, 2.ad Cor.11.25.

נוך Ch.& Syr. Vagari, errare, migrare, moveri, agitari. Aphel אניר Movere, commovere, agitare. Deinde quoq; eft Condolere, ut Hebraicè. Unde Pahel Præter. וַיָּנִידוּ לִיהּ Et Condoluerunt ipsi, Jobi 42.11.

נוח נית Chald.& Syr. Quiescere, Requiescere, Quiescere te se continere: Aphel אניח Quiescere, requiescere, cessare fecit, Requiem, quietem attulit, dedit vel largitus est: Refecit, refocillavit: Item Relinquere, Missum facere, ܕܫܝܘܢ Relinquamus ergo, Sic in Viennensi. In Regiis est ܢܝܚܘܢ Propellamus, ad Rom.13.12. Ethpeh. ܢܝܚܐ Quiescere, requiescere: Refici, refocillari: Ch. נתנח Quiescet, habitabit, cum ܐ ab initio & duplici ת, more Syro. Proverb.21.16.
ניחא, ניחא Chald. & Syr. Quies, Requies, tranquillitas, בניחא, Facile, leniter, quiete, lente, placide, tranquille, Genes.33.14. in Jon.
ניח ניחא Chald. Idem. בניח, Idem quod בניחא. Sic & בניחותא, ניחותא. Plur. emph. מי ניחיא Aquæ quietis, id est, tranquillæ, Psal.23.2.
מנח Ch. Idem: Item Aura, Genes.3.8.
מנחא Ch.Idem, בית מנחיכי In domum quietis tuę, Psal. 116.7.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek script in several entries is reproduced approximately; the exact vocalisation and diacritics in the Hebrew and Syriac forms could not be read with certainty. Marked uncertain: the Syriac and Hebrew forms in the first lines and the Aphel/Ethpeh forms.
